response: Based on the provided context, the right to rectification refers to the data subject's ability to obtain the rectification of inaccurate personal data concerning them from the controller without undue delay. Additionally, the data subject has the right to have incomplete personal data completed, including by means of providing a supplementary statement. This is outlined in Article 16 of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
